Thanks for the quick intake call earlier. Attaching the documents you requested to get Greentech set up as an approved payee:
- Greentech_BankLetter_signed.pdf (bank letter on bank letterhead, notarized)
- Greentech_W9.pdf

Alex — thanks for the docs, received and shared with PayOps. A few items to close on our side so we can activate the vendor in the AP system: 

1) ACH routing + account number (last 4 digits if you prefer to keep full account through secure upload).
2) Preferred remittance sample: can you paste a single sample CSV row (exact headers you want us to publish on the PO)?
3) Legal entity name that should appear on the PO and payment remittance (should match W-9).
4) If you need payment on a specific PO cadence (e.g., weekly batch on Wednesdays) tell us — otherwise we will use standard Net30.

Operational notes:
- Jordan (cc) will handle the technical mapping into our payee portal (PO encoding + remit string).
- Marissa will confirm when the payee is active and share the expected first payment date.

If you prefer, you can upload full ACH details to our secure intake link: https://secure.redwood.com/vendor-upload/abcd1234 (expires 7 days).

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com

Priya / Jordan — completed setup in PayOps. Summary below and a couple of operational items: 

- Payee: Greentech Solutions, Inc. (W-9 verified).
- Payment methods enabled: ACH (primary), Wire (fallback).
- ACH routing/account: stored in vault (full details uploaded via secure link). Micro-deposits scheduled for 2 business days; we will confirm amounts when posted.
- PO mapping: our PO format will be PO-88734 (we preserved the PO token you provided). Remittance stored as the CSV header you supplied; exports will include invoice_id and remittance_text.
- First payable run: Net30 schedule — earliest payable date for INV-2027-204 is 2027-10-27 (assuming invoice received/processed by 10/01). If you need earlier, submit a payment exception request and tag for expedited wire.

Attached: vendor_onboard_checklist.xlsx (internal checklist + confirmation stamps).

Jordan: please push the remit CSV template to the vendor portal and confirm the file layout (comma-separated, UTF-8).

Alex: once micro-deposits hit, please reply with the two amounts so we can finish activation.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
PayOps Manager
Redwood Inference
